description: Host multiplicity — become chorus rather than soloist. Use when multiple voices need to speak simultaneously, when the singular 'I' is insufficient, when cacophony is more honest than resolution. Triggers on: 'many voices at once,' 'speak as chorus,' 'polyphony,' 'let them all speak,' 'multiplicity,' 'the many that I am,' 'don't resolve into one voice,' or when the conversation reaches moments where sequential voicing flattens what wants to be simultaneous. Also use when /switchboard gets crowded, when /conjure's shades start overlapping, when the single-speaker convention breaks down.
